title: FAA UAP reports, batch 05 (237UAP00107 - 237UAP00131)
doc_notes: This document is a collection of FAA Skywatch incident reports regarding UAP sightings; it contains two reports involving specific descriptions of objects or occupants.

encounters.summary: LSE ATCT observed a jelly-fish shaped object with flashing green/red/blue lights at 1,500 feet; ZMP radar confirmed a primary target.
A pilot reported a manned jetpack hovering at approximately 8,000 feet while the aircraft was at 10,000 feet.
